name: Fickle Storm
text: When you play this card, choose its rank.
prototypeNote: As you play this card, use Edit card to set its rank.
archetypes: Exact Contractor, Nil Champion; splash High Card
family: Rank choice and swapping / Set on play
decision: When to play it and, after seeing the cards before it, which rank to give it: just high enough to win, or low enough to lose.
opponent: Visible when it resolves; players after it in the trick see the new rank and can still trump or overtake.
aiNote: Make it an ace if the team still needs tricks and no trump has been played; otherwise make it a two; play it last in a trick when possible.
rationale: One win or loss on demand is exactly what an exact count and a nil need. Choosing any rank, rather than only an ace or a two, lets it win as cheaply as possible or duck under a specific card, and it stays apart from Falling Star (BL-C03), which only lowers your aces.
deviation: Changed from playing as a two or an ace, which mirrored Falling Star, to choosing any rank.
